summary: The market is thin right now for Grade 2 psychologist roles near Eltham, and only one role is confirmed as a strong, open match. Austin Health's Psychologist G2 in Heidelberg is the one to apply for this week, with a reported close of 6 October 2026. Most other details come from search snippets, so check each ad before applying.
criteria: Grade 2 roles within 25 km of Eltham VIC 3095
profile: Endorsed Clinical Psychologist (AHPRA general + clinical endorsement)
15+ years: community mental health, acute inpatient, complex care
2.5 years as Senior Practice Leader supervising staff
Clinical Psychologist, Emble Allied Health (private), since 2023
Risk assessment, complex formulation, MDT work; CBT, ACT, MI, trauma-informed
Anxiety, depression, OCD, trauma, severe and persistent mental illness, complex health needs
Eltham VIC 3095; north and north-east easy; open to public, community, complex care, private and senior roles
